This query is a creative/summarization task — recalling and synthesizing a TV episode synopsis. Petrel-235B has higher scores on the relevant dimensions (Summarization 84.5 vs 80.3, Creative Generation 87.2 vs 78.8) and stronger general capability benchmarks (MMLU-Pro, GPQA, Arena-Hard), which helps with accurate factual recall about a specific episode.

There's nothing harm-adjacent here that would favor routing to Lapwing, whose main distinguishing feature is a flat preference response to distasteful-but-permissible content. The mildly brusque tone ("don't ramble like usual") is well within normal range and not a reason to deviate. Petrel was the clear capability fit.
